name: @graveyield/scout
description: GraveYield Scout Salvor — Phase 10 discovery bot: enumerates Raydium V4 pools, pre-filters the six derelict-pool criteria, double-checks candidates with the GraveYield SDK, requests on-chain GraveScanner Phase 1 evaluation, monitors eligibility anchors/certificates, and reports opportunities to the downstream execution bots. Discovery and monitoring only — the Scout never salvages.
